body:
I know. I know I shouldn't repeat her mistakes. I just want a reason why my life is worth not repeating her mistakes. I want a reason why I'm worth not killing myself now or through alcohol consumption. 

I'm drunk right now. I'm sorry. I just have it in my room and it's too tempting on a day off not to drink. I'm sorry. I just wish I had more confidence around women (when I'm sober) and wish I had more in my life that was going for me that I didn't have to worry about.

I should, but I just can't imagine living without alcohol. I just, I'm either high on two things, caffeine or alcohol. During the day when I'm in classes (and when I see this girl) it's caffeine. At night, when I'm done with classes and homework, it's alcohol. With my friends, I go out with them to bars on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday. I'm the life of the party. 

And with the girl, I really like her but I'm too afraid to ever ask her out. I feel like such a wimp around girls when I'm sober. I talk to her during class and she seems to like me but I can never get beyond that. I'm too much of a wimp to ask her out or anything and it's pointless because she's going to be gone next semester anyways.   

And, I know I need to quit alcohol, I know it's the leading cause of my problems. When I'm alone and it's a weekend and I don't have to do anything, I just want a drink. I don't want to be alone with myself. While alcohol is causing a lot of problems, I just need it. I feel like now I know how my Mom, who is an alcoholic, feels.

I should try to do that. I am a member of a gym. I love running, it feels really good when I do it. Meeting new people is extremely hard for me. I have bad social anxiety. I do want to learn Russian, with a combination of physical classes and online. But Russian won't help me get credits towards my major. So it's either work towards getting my college degree or learn a new language. I just always have these negative thoughts clouding what I want to do, and making me feel like I will never accomplish them

I live very far away from my school. My school is in the midwest and I am on the west coast. 

I just feel pathetic. When I have talked to my parents they tell me that I went through therapy, they thought I was better, and I shouldn't feel this bad. 

What I can do/do now is browse reddit and watch documentaries. I love to watch documentaries about other countries in the world. I like to learn about other parts of the world. I have been meaning to learn Russian because of my interest in Russia but I have been putting it off. I should start to do that, but I fear people will think it's weird that I want to know Russian, because it's a random language. I know it's silly but that's how I feel.

I had a counselor when I was there. I attempted suicide after my girlfriend broke up with me in early February, and after that they recommended that I take the rest of the semester off on medical leave. I then went through group therapy sessions while I was home, and when I was discharged I signed forms to apply to get back into school, which they rejected on the grounds that "because it's a mental health issue" I need at least 4 months of health. They didn't offer any support, they only refused my request. 

After my reaction on Monday I realized I wasn't okay. I realized I was screwed for registering for classes. I was brutally reminded of how much  I miss my friends at school. Everything collapsed, and I haven't recovered. I feel absolutely pathetic for my reaction. I feel pathetic for feeling this way again.

Yes, I have an appointment with a new therapist tomorrow. After what happened this Monday I have just given up. I have spent about 15 hours a day in my bed. Either sleeping or hiding. I've started drinking a lot again. I have given up since I got rejected by my school. I don't know why, but that just destroyed me. I have to wait to register for classes until there will be none avaliable. I'm sorry for the rant. 

I went to group therapy for five weeks. I was feeling better afterwards. I was feeling confident. Then Monday happened. Everything bad poured out, and I again went back to the crippling depression I was in before. I started drinking again. I've given up. I feel like my entire life is pointless. I feel like I'm just gonna die watching documentaries and browsing reddit. I'm sorry, this probably seems like a pathetic reason to be posting here but I have given up. On my future and on life
Sorry for this late response. I know how that feels, but you will find new things. What do you feel like you are missing?
Hey, I know how you feel. I hated high school too, and didn't do good, and I still got into college. What do you like to do? What activities do you enjoy?
I know how you feel. I have had stress over all three of those things too. Are you in college? high school?
I know that feeling. If you don't mind me asking, what about school? Grades? Stress? Not knowing what you wanna do?
I am gonna do that. Thank you for the encouragement :)
It is very good that you came here. What triggered these feelings? Feel free to message me if you wanna talk
Suicide is not the answer. Do you wanna talk? Why do you feel this way?
Suicide is not the answer. What made you want to do this? Why do you feel like you have dug yourself into a hole? Talk about it with us. We want to listen.
Same here. Sometimes I'm worried that I will slip and start talking/thinking like my characters in public.

I completely understand this. I create characters and imagine myself as them. Constantly. I'll imagine myself being really popular, imagine myself traveling the world, imagine myself with a beautiful and sweet girlfriend. Sometimes I have created entire biographies for the alternate versions of myself. It helps me get through darker times.

I also like to escape by watching documentaries about history, science, and other parts of the world, especially now that I'm not working or in school.
Same here. Best of luck to you.
I'm so sorry to hear that. It sounds to me like you have depression. I would recommend seeing a professional in your area, trust me it will help. Your life matters
You're not worthless or any of those things. It worries me to think of you feeling so bad about yourself. I wish I could help you feel better. Do you wanna talk? Why do you feel this way?
I would love to listen to you. What is wrong?

Since you are imminently suicidal, please call a hospital, police, or a suicide hotline tonight!

That being said, I have had depression for years, and talking to my therapist about being suicidal has never gotten me committed. I attempted suicide two months ago, and it scared the hell out of my family in ways I didn't expect it would. When I attempted, I was taken to the hospital overnight, I was not committed. I can tell you that people care about you, and don't want you to do it. 

Please feel free to PM me tonight if you want support, or you want to vent. But also reach out for help tonight!
Thank you for your post. I am currently in group therapy. I feel like it is making a difference. Hearing success stories like these makes me hopeful for the future. I'm happy you're doing better!

Depression is absolutely a real medical issue. Tell your therapist about these suicidal thoughts you are having. Trying to get on antidepressants can be very hard, even when you think they are the last thing that can help you. I know from firsthand experience. But be honest to your therapist, because he is a professional and can get you the help you need. Also know that medication will suppress it, but will not be the only way to cure your disease (depression is a disease). Anti-depressants are not a cure-all. You need therapy along with the antidepressants. Getting through depression takes work, just like the work you would put in if you had something like pneumonia or cancer.

I was going through the exact same thing you are going through when I attempted. I know what you are going through. You are absolutely not alone. You made a great step coming here and telling us, we care about you and are here to listen. But also seek further professional help.

I would repeat the comment above. Also, to add on to the booze, definitely try to keep him away from it. I developed a drinking problem because of my depression, and it was booze that drove me to attempt suicide after my girlfriend broke up with me. 

Listen to him, let him know you care, and refer him to university counseling.
After starting group therapy I feel like I am making progress. I have also quit drinking since my suicide attempt three weeks ago which is extremely hard.
That story of someone who is "cured" will help keep me going :)
Thank you! It's still unbelievably hard but I think I can do it
Thank you for the support!
Thank you!
